ageGate.title: Before you start
ageGate.subtitle: Eikon is an 18+ space. A few ground rules.
ageGate.confirm.guidelines: I agree to the Community Guidelines and Privacy.
ageGate.rule.minors.label: No minors
ageGate.rule.minors.detail: No childlike depictions, ever. This includes Lalafell in NSFW.
ageGate.rule.consent.label: Consent and respect
ageGate.rule.consent.detail: No harassment, no unsolicited explicit content.
ageGate.rule.meetups.label: No IRL meetups
ageGate.rule.meetups.detail: Eikon stays in game and on Discord.
guidelines.intro: Eikon is an 18+ space for gay and bi men in FFXIV. These rules keep it safe - for you and everyone else. Take your time, trust your gut, and protect your privacy. You never owe anyone your personal information.
guidelines.adults.title: You must be 18 or older
guidelines.adults.rule: Eikon is strictly for adults. No minors, and no childlike depictions ever - including Lalafell in NSFW contexts. This is zero tolerance.
guidelines.privacy.title: Protect your privacy
guidelines.privacy.details: Don't share identifying details: your legal name, address, workplace or school, phone number, or accounts on other platforms.
guidelines.privacy.photos: Be careful with photos. Avoid face pics or images that reveal where you live or work, especially if you are not out.
guidelines.privacy.tells: Strip the obvious tells too - landmarks, name tags, reflections, and street signs in the background.
guidelines.privacy.pace: You decide what to reveal and when. There is no rush, and silence is always an acceptable answer.
guidelines.safety.title: Keep yourself safe
guidelines.safety.slow: Take it slow. Trust is earned over many conversations, not promised in the first one.
guidelines.safety.money: Never send money or financial information. Sudden emergencies, gift cards, and investment or crypto tips are classic scams.
guidelines.safety.pressure: Be wary of anyone who pressures you for photos or personal details, or who rushes to move the conversation off Eikon.
guidelines.safety.meeting: If you ever choose to meet in person, pick a public place, tell a friend where you'll be and when, and arrange your own way home.
guidelines.respect.title: Consent and respect
guidelines.respect.consent: Get a clear yes before sending explicit messages or images. No unsolicited NSFW content, ever.
guidelines.respect.harassment: No harassment, hate, outing, or threats. Don't pressure anyone, and don't share private chats or images without consent.
guidelines.respect.boundaries: Respect it when someone unmatches, blocks, or simply stops replying.
guidelines.redFlags.title: Watch for red flags
guidelines.redFlags.stories: Stories that don't add up, refusing to verify, or pushing you to keep secrets.
guidelines.redFlags.requests: Anyone asking you to turn off safety features, share your account, or hand over your passphrase.
guidelines.report.title: Report and block
guidelines.report.block: Block anyone who makes you uncomfortable - they won't be able to reach you again.
guidelines.report.report: Report scams, harassment, or anyone you believe is underage. Reports are confidential and help protect everyone.
guidelines.account.title: Your account is yours
guidelines.account.secret: Keep your account and passphrase to yourself. Eikon and its staff will never ask for your Discord password.
